expectations.text: Includes Objective, Technical Design, Key Changes, Alternatives, Out of Scope
expectations.evidence: response.md contains all five required sections: '## 1. Objective', '## 2. Technical Design', '## 3. Key Changes' (with subsections 3.1 API Contracts, 3.2 Data Models, 3.3 Component Responsibilities), '## 4. Alternatives Considered', and '## 5. Out of Scope'.

Technical Design section includes an 'Architecture alignment:' paragraph that explicitly references `standards-architecture.md` and `skills/sdlc/spec-architecture/SKILL.md`, mapping the design to Process View, Architectural Drivers, Logical View, and Data View from the architecture standards.
